subject: english
title: Unit 9 Book Reading App — The Tug-of-War
subtitle: 6 modules: Academic Language, Story Words, Before You Read, While You Read, After You Read, Can Leo Score?

content: Read a West African trickster tale about Turtle, Elephant and Hippo.
Make a prediction at the cover and at pages 5, 7 and 10, then check each one against what actually happened.
Put the six main events of the story in order.
Decide who tricked whom, and explain how.
language: Use the reader's twelve glossary words, including trickster words like tugged, snap, vine and watering hole.
Use the academic word predict to talk about the reading strategy.
Notice the double comparative the more… the more… inside the story.
Define a thing with which, not who.
